title.narrative: Strengthening Open Science Implementation mechanisms and STI policies in EA

description.narrative: This project strengthens scientific and technological cooperation across EA to make research more open, inclusive, and useful to the public. Building on initial baseline data, the initiative dives deeper into how these countries can securely connect their public research databases. To address environmental challenges, the project will explore how artificial intelligence, internet-connected sensors, and community-led public science programs can work together to monitor water resources, weather disasters, and ecosystems. Finally, it could help universities update their evaluation systems to reward researchers who share data openly and collaborate with local communities. Key deliverables include advanced guidelines for regional data systems, community monitoring toolkits, and policy guides for modernizing academic research metrics and assessment.
